in_sanskrit.name: Sharvan
in_sanskrit.meaning: Having the radiance of the moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word 'sharva' which means 'having the radiance of the moon', and the suffix 'an' which means 'having' or 'belonging to'. Therefore, 'Sharvan' can be interpreted as 'having the radiance of the moon'. The suffix 'Kar' may be added to indicate 'doer' or 'maker'.

in_hindi.name: शर्वणकार
in_hindi.meaning: व्यक्ति जो चंद्रके रूपकार्य का कारा है
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is a combination of the Sanskrit word 'Sharvan' and the Hindi suffix 'Kar'. 'Sharvan' means 'having the radiance of the moon', and 'Kar' means 'doer' or 'maker'. Therefore, 'Sharvankaar' can be interpreted as 'doer or maker of the radiance of the moon'.
